collection.boundary: A site owner may wire a collector that accepts docs-events.schema.json only after selecting a provider, legal basis, retention policy, and consent treatment. VextJS ships no tracker or collector.

metrics.definition: A page view grouped only by canonical page, locale, and referrer class.

reviewCadence: Review wording and developer journeys monthly; do not infer revenue, identity, or conversion from this contract alone.
